name: Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics
description:
Connect Claude to your marketing stack with Two Minute Reports. Analyze PPC, SEO, social media, ecommerce, email marketing, and analytics data from Google Ads, Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Search Ads, Amazon Ads, Pinterest Ads, Reddit Ads, Snapchat Ads, Twitter Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google My Business, PageSpeed Insights, Google Trends, Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller Central, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Facebook Insights, Instagram Insights, LinkedIn Pages, and YouTube Analytics — all in one place.

Ask questions in natural language and instantly get insights on CTR, CPC, conversions, ROAS, ad spend, SEO performance, social media engagement, ecommerce revenue, and marketing performance across channels.

Built for marketing agencies, ecommerce brands, growth teams, and data analysts, it turns multi-platform marketing data into clear, actionable insights directly inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.twominutereports.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics lists 34 MCP tools, including add_client_account, create_client, create_dashboard, create_goal, disable_account, enable_account, get_client, get_connection, get_connection_accounts, get_connector_accounts, get_connector_query_schema, and get_dashboard.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two Minute Reports For Marketing Analytics is developed by Two Minute Reports. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
